intro: Apps only get access to the camera, microphone, files and more if you allow it. Decisions are kept here; an app can’t change them.
ask.keyring: “{app}” wants to use a password that “{owner}” saved in the keyring
ask.keyringNote: Only this item is shared, and only with this app.
ask.where: You can change this later in Settings → Privacy.
permHint.camera: Apps that asked to use the camera.
permHint.microphone: Apps that asked to use the microphone.
permHint.screen: Apps that asked to record the screen.
permHint.files: Apps open and save files through the system dialog.
permHint.network: Apps that asked to use the network.
permHint.clipboard: Apps that asked to read the clipboard.
permHint.notifications: Apps that asked to send notifications.
permHint.apps: Apps that asked to launch other apps.
permHint.listen: Apps that asked to accept network connections.
permHint.usb: Apps that asked to use USB devices.
permHint.bluetooth: Apps that asked to use Bluetooth.
permHint.screen-share: Apps that may show your screen and play your sound to people they connect you with. Revoking ends a running share.
permHint.remote-input: Apps that may let those people use your mouse, keyboard and clipboard.
